changes.summary: a container with the Page N of M indicator, Prev/Next dispatching pageChanged, and Rotate dispatching rotated; the hook reads the viewport selectors.
renders PageControls above the page list inside a flex column.
renderPage and renderTextLayer take a Rotation and build the viewport with it, so the page itself turns.
passes the rotation prop to both render calls.

decisions: The control dispatches the slice actions; the window and every layer already follow the slice, so no second page source.
Rotation goes to the pdfjs viewport, not a CSS transform, so the text layer and hit geometry stay aligned.
Prev/Next rather than a scroll observer for now.
